subject: Penetration test deliverables & remediation roadmap (AcmeCorp)
messages:
From: reports@kestrelsec.com (Kestrel Pentest)
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: sec-eng@acmecorp.com
Date: Sun, 08 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Delivery: Penetration test report (AcmeCorp engagement)

Hi Mina / Dev team,

Attached is the final penetration test report for the AcmeCorp engagement (conducted 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-05). Executive summary: overall posture is good; we validated multiple medium/high findings that we recommend remediation for production systems. Key findings called out below — full details in the PDF.

High / Actionable findings (summary):
- AUTH-101: JWT validation bypass on /api/v1/session (missing audience and expiry enforcement).
- LOG-205: Sensitive auth failures not captured as structured audit events; missing correlation IDs for login flows.
- SECRET-303: Several build artifacts and one legacy service contain hardcoded API keys to third-party payment gateway.
- NET-402: Management ports (SSH, Redis admin) reachable from internal subnet ranges without explicit firewall rules.
- PERM-508: Overprivileged roles (service-role/legacy-worker) allow write access to customer metadata S3 prefixes.

We recommend a prioritized remediation plan and evidence artifacts to support SOC2/SIG: code PRs, configuration diffs, audit logs, rotation evidence, and retest of high items. Please confirm the remediation owner and ETAs for each finding and whether you want a scoped retest for the high items only or a full validation run.

Attachment: kestrel-pen-test-report-20260205.pdf (PDF, 3.2 MB)

Thanks,
Alex R. Stone
Senior Consultant — Kestrel Pentest
reports@kestrelsec.com

--
Kestrel Pentest, LLC
https://kestrelsec.com
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: reports@kestrelsec.com (Kestrel Pentest), sec-eng@acmecorp.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 09 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Delivery: Penetration test report (AcmeCorp engagement)

Alex / Acme security team — thanks for the report and clear prioritization. We appreciate the high-level summary; I've attached our remediation tracker and mapped owners/ETAs for the high-priority items. We'll provide interim evidence as items become available. High-level plan below (owners and firm ETAs):

1) AUTH-101 (JWT validation bypass)
- Immediate mitigation: added stricter token validation middleware to reject tokens missing exp/iss/aud and require signature verification.
- Next steps: rotate signing keys, add automated unit + integration tests.
- Owner: dev_patel@redwood.ai
- ETA for code rollout to staging: 2026-02-18
- ETA for production rollout / key rotation: 2026-02-19

2) NET-402 (management ports exposure)
- Immediate mitigation: implemented deny-by-default firewall rules in staging and scheduled infra change for production to restrict access to admin ports to a bastion.
- Owner: dev_patel@redwood.ai (infra workstream)
- ETA for production firewall rule: 2026-02-18

3) LOG-205 (auth/logging gaps)
- Scope: add structured login/logout/audit events with correlation_id, ensure retention for 90 days in central logging cluster.
- Artifacts: PRs will include structured log schema and mapping; we will send sample logs and retention policy change.
- Owner: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
- ETA for staging instrumentation: 2026-02-22
- ETA for production: 2026-02-26

4) SECRET-303 (hardcoded API keys)
- Action: removed keys from repo, rotated compromised keys with vendor, moved secrets to Vault (AWS Secrets Manager) with access controlled by IAM roles.
- Artifacts: commit hashes, PRs, rotation logs, and Vault access policy snapshots will be attached.
- Owner: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
- ETA for full secret purge and rotation: 2026-03-05

5) PERM-508 (overprivileged roles)
- Action: audit of service-role/legacy-worker, created least-privilege policy proposals, will submit role remap PRs and run access validation.
- Owner: dev_patel@redwood.ai
- ETA for role remap in staging: 2026-03-01
- ETA for prod rollout: 2026-03-12

Attachments: redwood-remediation-tracker-20260212.xlsx
Related: JIRA-SEC-4782 (tracking tickets and evidence uploads).

Question for Kestrel: for retest scope — we propose an initial targeted retest for AUTH-101 and NET-402 once those changes are in prod (requested ETA for interim evidence: 2026-02-22). Would you accept staged evidence (PR links + logs) for LOG-205 and SECRET-303 ahead of a full retest?

I'll follow up with the team to post artifacts to the Drive link and Jira.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0179
From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, reports@kestrelsec.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration test deliverables & remediation roadmap (AcmeCorp)

Mina — quick operational notes from infra/dev side: attaching the planned firewall change PR and list of CLs for key rotation. Evidence we will collect per item:
- AUTH-101: PR (#2945), integration test logs, key rotation event from KMS (rotation-id: rot-20260219-01).
- NET-402: terraform change (tfsec-accept), iptables rule diff, bastion access config; will provide test connectivity matrix showing management ports blocked from non-bastion subnets.
- PERM-508: role mapping PRs and an automated policy-sim run showing denied write attempts to customer S3 prefixes.

ETA confirmations: PROD firewall changes scheduled 2026-02-18 02:00-03:00 UTC (maintenance window). AUTH rollout and key rotation targeted 2026-02-19. I will upload PR links and rotation audit to JIRA-SEC-4782 as they merge.

On the secrets item: Grace and I coordinated — we will perform a repo scan and provide a list of removed artifacts + vendor rotation certificates. Expect initial artifacts by 2026-02-20.

— Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
Redwood Inference
From: reports@kestrelsec.com (Kestrel Pentest)
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: sec-eng@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Penetration test deliverables & remediation roadmap (AcmeCorp)

Thanks Mina / Dev — this plan looks reasonable. Confirming Kestrel availability for a targeted retest window: 2026-02-23 to 2026-02-25 for AUTH-101 and NET-402 (we can scope 4 hours). For LOG-205 and SECRET-303 we can validate artifacts you upload; we'll accept staged evidence as long as it includes the PR + audited logs/rotation events and is available by 2026-02-22. For PERM-508 we recommend post-remap access validation in the 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-14 window.

Please upload initial evidence to the Drive link and add notes in JIRA-SEC-4782. Once we validate the high items we will provide a remediation verification letter for AcmeCorp's SOC2 evidence package.

Attachment: none (we will request retest access details through Atlassian ticket).

Regards,
Alex Stone
Kestrel Pentest — Red Team Operations
